scope_note: SG-MA-PHARMACIST-ADMINISTRATION after a further correction following the V10V audit. The section now treats both open points in the sentence of Circular Letter DCP 26-03-124 on reporting to the Board the same way: who carries the responsibility, and which events it covers. On its face the sentence names every dispensing error and every serious adverse drug event; the texts do not settle whether "in accordance with Board regulations" narrows that set or only governs the manner of reporting (247 CMR 20.01). Statements limited to 247 CMR 20.02 and M.G.L. c. 112, s. 39D stay as accurate statements about those texts. One safe course is used throughout: the administering pharmacist or intern gets the event to the Manager of Record at once, a Board report is made for any event the circular names even where 20.02 and s. 39D would not require one, and the reports those texts require are made within their time limits. Changed: orientation[8], exceptions[8], common_traps[20]-[22], decision_logic[13], learning_objectives[7], a new comparison_tables[5] row, retrieval_prompts[24], [25] and a new [26], quick_review[18], forms_records[9] and role_duties[9]. New rule: MA-BOARD-REPORT-MANNER-AND-FORMAT (247 CMR 20.01). Scope gate: the same 13 actionable signals as the previous freeze are declined (collaborative drug therapy management prescribing, MA-PHARMACIST-PRESCRIBER-ID, and contraception and expedited partner therapy records). All six practice links stay.
